data.title: Arknights: Endfield x Beard Papa's collaboration coming soon
data.brief:
The Arknights: Endfield × Beard Papa’s collaboration in the U.S. will launch on April 3.
Event Dura
data.data:
The Arknights: Endfield × Beard Papa’s collaboration in the U.S. will launch on April 3.


Event Duration

April 3, 2026 (Fri.) – May 12, 2026 (Tue.)


Event Locations

All participating Beard Papa’s stores in the United States


Event Details

1. The collaboration will be available in the U.S. from April 3 to May 12, 2026.

2. Purchase a designated collaboration combo set to receive exclusive merchandise and in-game rewards.

3. Two collaboration sets will be available:

a . Endfield Expedition Set (4-Pack)

- 4 Limited-Time Operator Cream Puffs

- Game Code Card (redeemable for in-game rewards)

- Exclusive Character Keychain

- Sticker Set

b. Endfield Command Set (6-Pack)

- 4 Limited-Time Operator Cream Puffs

- 2 Original Beard Papa’s Cream Puffs

- Game Code Card

- Exclusive Character Keychain

- Sticker Set

- Collectible Character Badge

4. Select stores will feature themed takeovers during the collaboration period:

- Little Tokyo, Los Angeles - April 18, 12:00 PM – 5:00 PM (Local Time)

- Katy, Texas - April 19, 12:00 PM – 5:00 PM (Local Time)

Cosplayers will be present at both locations during these times for fan photo opportunities.


Additional Information

1. Collaboration items and bonuses are available while supplies last.

2. Redemption codes can be used once per game account.

3. Availability may vary by store.

4. For more information, please visit: https://www.beardpapas.com/endfield
